spots.name: Sacajawea Peak
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 3,000 m (9,843 ft).

spots.name: Ice Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt. About 146 m (480 ft) tall.

spots.name: Joseph Canyon Viewpoint
